title: Operator Responsibility Structured Approval Modal Decision
claim: FP-MCP-280 records that operator responsibility remains the approval authority, but structured human approval evidence was not recorded: the full approval payload was platform-blocked, the compact pre-boundary retry failed closed inside ForgePilot, and the compact post-boundary retry was platform-blocked before reaching MCP; the prepared FP-MCP-276 request remains unapproved and on hold.
summary: FP-MCP-280 attempted to use the native MCP approval modal as the final confirmation for recording structured human approval evidence, rather than requiring typed APPROVE/HOLD/DENY in chat. The operator responsibility doctrine was recorded: the human operator owns authorization, policy judgment, and final responsibility; GPT prepares scope and evidence; ForgePilot records decisions and enforces boundaries. The first full structured approval tool call was blocked by the platform before reaching MCP. A compact retry reached ForgePilot but correctly failed closed because FP-MCP-280 did not yet exist and the workspace was dirty. FP-MCP-280 then created an approval boundary checkpoint so the approval packet existed and the workspace returned clean. A final compact retry was again platform-blocked before reaching MCP. No structured human approval evidence was created. No local clearance was created. No approval was consumed. No disable switch was cleared. No runner start endpoint was contacted. No OpenCode action occurred. The request REQ-20260704T115428653Z-fc0b6275 remains prepared but unapproved.
caveats: This result is a HOLD, not an approval.
The user did not deny the request; the approval tool path was blocked by the platform after one fail-closed validation inside ForgePilot.
The approval expiry timestamp used in attempts was 2026-07-04T12:41:40Z and should not be reused later.
Future work should not retry the same approval payload repeatedly; it should design a lower-risk approval evidence path or revise the approval modal interaction contract.
The FP-MCP-276 request remains non-executing and unapproved.
